units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 9:1:6">Y. Pes. IX, 36ᵈ</cite> top (ref. to <he>וחדל לעשות</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 9:13">Num. IX, 13</cite>) <he>החדל בשעת ע׳</he> he who fails (to sacrifice, without being prevented) at the time when the Passover sacrifice is to be done.
<cite ref="Numbers 9:13">Ib.</cite> <he>חוץ לַעֲשִׂיָּיתוֹ</he> out of the time of doing it.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 4:4:11">Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 26:1">Lev. XXVI, 1</cite>) <he>ע׳ בתחלה קימה וכ׳</he> ‘ye shall not make’ refers to the original making and putting up, ‘ye shall not put up’ means that you must not erect it when it has fallen down.
<cite ref="Megillah 17a:7">Meg. 17ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ע׳</he> celebrating (Purim, <cite ref="Esther 9:27">Esth. IX, 27</cite>), contrad. to <cite ref="G00464"><he>זְכִירָה</he></cite>.

Sifré Deut. 212 (ref. to Deut. XXI, 12) נאמר כאן ע׳ ונאמרה ע׳ וכ׳ here is an action mentioned concerning the head, and a doing is named concerning the nails מה ע׳ האמורה וכ׳ as the action concerning the head means removing (the hair), so &c.; Yeb. 48ᵃ; a. fr.—Pl. עֲשִׂיּוֹת.

<cite ref="Yoma 55a:9">Yoma 55ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 16:15">Lev. XVI, 15</cite>) <he>שיהיו כל עֲשִׂיּוֹתָיו שוות</he> that all his actions (sprinklings) should be alike. Ib. 71ᵇ, sq.; a. e.—[<cite ref="P01476"><he>עשייה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Ketubot 53a:2">Keth. 53ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="P01475"><he>עֲשֵׂי</he></cite>.]
